definition_en: a person whose job is to gather news and tell the public about it
core_image: 拿着话筒和笔记本的人，把远处的消息带回编辑部
scene: 发布会还没结束，前排的记者已经把要点发回编辑部。The reporter filed the story before the room emptied.
sceneCN: 这里 reporter 是「记者」（第 1 个义项：采集并报道新闻的人）；句意：记者在会场散场前就把报道发了回去。

senses.title: A news journalist
senses.definition: a person who collects information and writes or broadcasts news
senses.definitionCN: 采集信息并撰写或播报新闻的人
senses.example: A reporter stopped him outside the station.
senses.exampleCN: 一名记者在车站外拦住了他。
senses.why: The -er ending marks the person who performs the action of reporting, so the basic sense is the news worker.
senses.whyCN: -er 词尾标记执行 report 这一动作的人，所以基本义就是新闻工作者。

senses.title: A person who reports something
senses.definition: someone who gives an official account of an event to an authority
senses.definitionCN: 向权威机构正式说明某事件的人
senses.example: The reporter of the accident gave a clear statement.
senses.exampleCN: 事故报告人作了清楚的陈述。
senses.why: Anyone who carries information to an authority can be called a reporter, not only a journalist.
senses.whyCN: 任何把信息带给权威机构的人都可以叫 reporter，并不限于记者。

senses.title: A court stenographer
senses.definition: a person who records the words spoken in a court
senses.definitionCN: 记录法庭上发言内容的人
senses.example: The court reporter typed every word of the testimony.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭记录员打下了证词的每一个字。
senses.why: Recording speech for the record is another specialised form of reporting what was said.
senses.whyCN: 为存档记录发言，是「报告所说内容」的另一种专业形式。

intro.en: Reporter is report plus the agent ending -er, so it names the person who carries information back.
intro.cn: reporter 是 report 加施事词尾 -er，指把信息带回来的人。

items.en: Reportare means to carry back news, from re- and portare.
items.cn: reportare 意为带回消息，由 re- 与 portare 构成。

items.en: Old French reporter supplies the verb that English shortens to report.
items.cn: 古法语 reporter 提供动词，英语将其简化为 report。

items.en: Middle English report names both the telling and the account.
items.cn: 中古英语 report 既指讲述，也指叙述。

items.en: The agent noun reporter appears for someone who brings news.
items.cn: 施事名词 reporter 出现，指带来消息的人。

items.en: Newspapers make reporter a regular job title.
items.cn: 报纸使 reporter 成为固定的职业名称。

items.en: Modern English extends it to court recorders and official informants.
items.cn: 现代英语把它扩展到法庭记录员和正式报告人。

note.en: Reporter is the person noun of the report family, and it sits beside other names for news workers.
note.cn: reporter 是 report 词族中表示人的名词，与其它新闻工作者名称相邻。

entries.definition: to give an account of something
the style of written news reporting
a person who writes for newspapers or broadcasts
a reporter based in a particular place or field
a writer who produces a regular opinion column
a person who reads news or introduces programmes

normalIntro.en: Reporter is report plus -er, so the spelling itself says a person who reports.
normalIntro.cn: reporter 就是 report 加 -er，拼写本身就在说「做报道的人」。

normal.en: Report plus -er: the one who carries the news back.
normal.cn: report 加 -er：把消息带回来的人。

normal.en: A news reporter works where events are happening.
normal.cn: news reporter 工作在事件发生的地方。

normal.en: An investigative reporter digs for hidden facts.
normal.cn: investigative reporter 专门挖掘隐藏的事实。

normal.en: A court reporter records what is said in court.
normal.cn: court reporter 记录法庭上的发言。

normal.en: Compare report and reporter: one is the act, one is the person.
normal.cn: 对比 report 与 reporter：一个是动作，一个是人。

abstract.en: Picture a notebook and microphone moving through a crowd.
abstract.cn: 想象笔记本和话筒在人群中移动。

abstract.en: Imagine a press pass hanging from a lanyard at the front row.
abstract.cn: 想象前排挂着记者证的挂绳。

abstract.en: Think of a voice sending facts from a dark street into a bright studio.
abstract.cn: 想象一个声音把事实从暗街送进明亮的演播室。

examples.en: The reporter interviewed three witnesses.
examples.cn: 记者采访了三名目击者。

examples.en: She works as a sports reporter for a local paper.
examples.cn: 她在一家地方报纸做体育记者。

examples.en: Reporters waited outside the court for a statement.
examples.cn: 记者们在法庭外等待声明。

dict_mnemonic.text: report（报道）+ -er（做某事的人）＝记者；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: report（报告，源自拉丁语 reportare「带回」）+ 施事词尾 -er，指采集并传递消息的人。

sensesIntro.en: The suffix -er gives the person: first the news worker, then anyone who reports officially, then the court recorder.
sensesIntro.cn: 词尾 -er 给出「人」：先是新闻工作者，再是任何正式报告者，最后是法庭记录员。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person carrying news from the scene back to the desk.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人把消息从现场带回编辑桌。

branches.en: The news worker is the everyday and central sense.
branches.cn: 新闻工作者，是最日常、最核心的义项。

branches.en: Anyone who gives an official account is a reporter in the broad sense.
branches.cn: 任何作出正式陈述的人，都是广义上的报告人。

branches.en: The court recorder reports speech into a permanent record.
branches.cn: 法庭记录员把发言报告成永久记录。

branches.en: Journalist and official informant both carry information to others.
branches.cn: 记者与正式报告人都在把信息带给他人。

branches.en: Both gather words at the scene and preserve them for later readers.
branches.cn: 两者都在现场收集话语，并为后来的读者保存。

intro.en: Reporter is a transparent English agent noun: report plus -er.
intro.cn: reporter 是一个构词透明的英语施事名词：report 加 -er。

latinIntro.en: The base report comes from Latin reportare, to carry back, and -er marks the person who does it.
latinIntro.cn: 基础词 report 来自拉丁语 reportare（带回），-er 标记执行该动作的人。

items.example: Report is the base of reporter.
items.exampleCN: report 是 reporter 的基础词。

items.example: The suffix -er turns report into reporter.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -er 把 report 变成 reporter。
reporter 由 report 与 -er 合成。
reportage 共享 report 词干。

items.meaningCN: 表示集合或过程的名词词尾

items.exampleCN: reportedly 共享 report 词干。

definition_en: to act or speak for someone, to stand for something, or to show something in a picture or description
core_image: 一个人站在一群人前面，把大家的意思带到会议桌上
scene: 村里选出一个人去城里开会，他要代表所有住户表达对修路的需求。She was chosen to represent the village at the meeting.
sceneCN: 这里 represent 是「代表」（第 1 个义项：代替某人或某群体发言、行事）；句意：她被选出来代表全村去开会。

senses.title: To act or speak for others
senses.definition: to act or speak officially for a person, group, or organization
senses.definitionCN: 正式代替某人、某群体或某组织行事或发言
senses.example: The lawyer represents several families in the case.
senses.exampleCN: 这位律师在案件中代表好几个家庭。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to make present, so representing is making an absent group present through one person.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「使在场」，所以代表就是让不在场的群体通过一个人「到场」。

senses.title: To stand for something
senses.definition: to be a sign or symbol of something
senses.definitionCN: 作为某事物的标志或象征
senses.example: On the map, a red dot represents a hospital.
senses.exampleCN: 在地图上，红点表示医院。
senses.why: A symbol makes an idea present to the eye, which is the same logic as a person standing for a group.
senses.whyCN: 符号让一个概念在眼前「在场」，这与人代表群体的逻辑相同。

senses.title: To show in picture or words
senses.definition: to describe or show something in a particular way
senses.definitionCN: 以某种方式描述或呈现某事物
senses.example: The painting represents the harvest as a celebration.
senses.exampleCN: 这幅画把丰收描绘成一场庆典。
senses.why: A picture makes a scene present again, extending the core idea from people to images.
senses.whyCN: 图画让一个场景再次「在场」，把核心概念从人扩展到图像。

senses.title: To amount to something
senses.definition: to be equivalent to something, or to count as an example of it
senses.definitionCN: 等同于某事物，或算作某事物的一例
senses.example: The delay represents a serious loss for the company.
senses.exampleCN: 这次延误对公司来说相当于严重损失。
senses.why: If something stands for a value or result, it can also count as that result in practice.
senses.whyCN: 如果某物代表某种价值或结果，它在实际中也就可以算作那个结果。

intro.en: Represent comes from Latin repraesentare, to make present, built from re- and praesentare, to present.
intro.cn: represent 来自拉丁语 repraesentare（使在场），由 re- 与 praesentare（呈现）构成。

items.en: Praesens means present or being at hand, and praesentare means to make present.
items.cn: praesens 意为在场的、手边的，praesentare 意为使在场。

items.en: Repraesentare adds re- and means to bring something before the eyes or mind.
items.cn: repraesentare 加上 re-，意为把某物带到眼前或心中。

items.en: The verb is used for showing an image, a person, or an idea.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语中，该动词用于呈现图像、人物或观念。

items.en: Old French representer carries the senses of showing and standing for.
items.cn: 古法语 representer 同时有「展示」和「代表」的意思。

items.en: Middle English represent covers speaking for others and depicting scenes.
items.cn: 中古英语 represent 涵盖替人发言和描绘场景。

items.en: Modern English adds the sense of amounting to or constituting something.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「相当于、构成」这一义项。

note.en: Represent is the verb at the centre of a family about standing in for something, and it sits near words for symbol and depiction.
note.cn: represent 是「代替某物出场」这一词族的中心动词，与表示象征和描绘的词相邻。

entries.definition: the act of representing or something that represents
a person chosen to act for others
showing things as they appear in real life
to be a symbol of something
to show something in a picture or description
to give a visible or concrete form to an idea
to be a sign or short form of something

normalIntro.en: Represent is re- plus present, so the memory hook is making something present again through a person, sign, or picture.
normalIntro.cn: represent 就是 re- 加 present，记忆钩子是「通过人、符号或图画让某物再次在场」。

normal.en: Re- means again, and present means here: make the group present again through one speaker.
normal.cn: re- 表示再次，present 表示在场：通过一个发言者让群体再次到场。

normal.en: A red dot on a map represents a hospital by making it visible.
normal.cn: 地图上的红点通过「可见」来代表医院。

normal.en: The ending -ation turns the verb into the noun representation.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ation 把动词变成名词 representation。

normal.en: The ending -ative turns it into representative, the person or the adjective.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ative 把它变成 representative，可指人或作形容词。

normal.en: Represent an improvement means the thing amounts to an improvement.
normal.cn: represent an improvement 意为该事物相当于一种改进。

abstract.en: Picture one person carrying a whole village's questions into a meeting room.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人把整个村子的问题带进会议室。

abstract.en: Imagine a small icon standing in for a large building on a screen.
abstract.cn: 想象屏幕上一枚小图标代替一栋大楼。

abstract.en: Think of a portrait making an absent face look present.
abstract.cn: 想象一幅肖像让不在场的面孔重新出现。

examples.en: She represents the company in Asia.
examples.cn: 她代表公司在亚洲开展工作。

examples.en: In this diagram, each circle represents a cell.
examples.cn: 在这张图里，每个圆圈表示一个细胞。

examples.en: The new rules represent a major change.
examples.cn: 新规定相当于一次重大变化。

dict_mnemonic.text: re-（再次）+ present（呈现）＝让不在场的人或事再次呈现，即代表；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: 拉丁语 re-（再次）+ praesens（在场的）→ praesentare（使在场）→ repraesentare（呈现、代表）→ 古法语 representer → 中古英语 represent。

sensesIntro.en: Making something present is the core: a person makes a group present, a sign makes an idea present, a picture makes a scene present, and a fact can make a result present.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「使某物在场」：人让群体在场，符号让观念在场，图画让场景在场，而事实可以让结果在场。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one person or sign standing in so that something absent becomes present.
core.cn: 核心意象：由一个人或符号代替出场，使缺席之物重新在场。

branches.en: Acting for a group is the central political and legal sense.
branches.cn: 替群体行事，是最核心的政治与法律义项。

branches.en: A symbol makes an idea present to the eye.
branches.cn: 符号让观念在眼前呈现。

branches.en: A picture makes a scene present again in description.
branches.cn: 图画在描述中让场景再次呈现。

branches.en: A fact can make a consequence present by counting as it.
branches.cn: 事实可以通过「算作」某种后果而使之在场。

branches.en: Delegates and symbols both stand in for something larger.
branches.cn: 代表与符号都在代替更大的事物出场。

intro.en: Represent is built from Latin parts, and its English family grows through noun and adjective endings.
intro.cn: represent 由拉丁语成分构成，其英语词族通过名词和形容词词尾扩展。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- adds again, and praesentare means to make present, from praesens, present.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 增添「再次」，praesentare 意为「使在场」，来自 praesens（在场的）。

items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 represent 与 present 开头。

items.example: Praesens is the source of the present element.
items.exampleCN: praesens 是 present 这一成分的来源。

items.example: Praesentare gives represent its showing sense.
items.exampleCN: praesentare 给 represent 提供「呈现」的含义。
repraesentare 由 re- 与 praesentare 合成。

items.example: Represent carries the Latin verb into English.
items.exampleCN: represent 把拉丁动词带入英语。

items.meaning: the act or result of representing

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词词尾

definition_en: the act of politely asking for something, or the thing that is asked for
core_image: 一个人轻轻敲门，把写着自己需要的纸条递进去，等待对方点头
scene: 客人把需要更多毛巾的请求写在卡片上，前台很快送来了。Her request for an extra towel was met within minutes.
sceneCN: 这里 request 是「请求」（第 1 个义项：礼貌地开口要求某事）；句意：她要一条额外毛巾的请求几分钟内就得到了满足。

senses.title: The act of asking politely
senses.definition: the act of asking for something in a polite or formal way
senses.definitionCN: 以礼貌或正式方式提出要求的行为
senses.example: She made a request for more time.
senses.exampleCN: 她请求多给一些时间。
senses.why: The word comes from a verb meaning to seek again, so the core sense is the act of asking.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自意为「再次寻求」的动词，所以核心义是「开口要求」这个动作。

senses.title: The thing asked for
senses.definition: the thing that someone asks for
senses.definitionCN: 某人要求得到的东西
senses.example: His request was simple: a quiet room.
senses.exampleCN: 他的请求很简单：一间安静的房间。
senses.why: The act of asking easily becomes the name of what is asked for.
senses.whyCN: 「请求」这个动作很容易转指「被请求的东西」。

senses.title: To ask formally
senses.definition: to ask for something in a polite or official way
senses.definitionCN: 以礼貌或正式的方式要求某事
senses.example: Guests are requested to keep their voices low.
senses.exampleCN: 请客人保持低声。
senses.why: The verb simply puts the noun's action into grammatical form, with the same polite or official tone.
senses.whyCN: 动词只是把名词所指的动作变成语法形式，礼貌或正式的语气保持不变。

intro.en: Request comes through Old French requeste from Latin requirere, to seek again, from re- and quaerere, to seek.
intro.cn: request 经古法语 requeste 来自拉丁语 requirere（再次寻求），由 re- 与 quaerere（寻求）构成。

items.en: Quaerere means to seek, ask, or inquire, and it also gives us question.
items.cn: quaerere 意为寻求、询问或探问，也是 question 的来源。

items.en: Requirere adds re- and means to seek again or ask for something needed.
items.cn: requirere 加上 re-，意为再次寻求或索取所需之物。

items.en: The noun requesta names a formal asking or petition.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语名词 requesta 指正式的请求或请愿。

items.en: Old French requeste carries the noun into English with a polite tone.
items.cn: 古法语 requeste 把这个名词带入英语，并带有礼貌语气。

items.en: Middle English request covers both the asking and the thing asked for.
items.cn: 中古英语 request 既指请求动作，也指所请求之物。

items.en: Modern English uses request as both noun and verb in formal settings.
items.cn: 现代英语中，request 在正式场合兼作名词和动词。

note.en: Request belongs to the seek-and-ask family, and it is close to words for appeals, applications, and demands.
note.cn: request 属于「寻求与询问」词族，与呼吁、申请和要求类词相邻。

entries.definition: something that is needed or demanded
a person who makes a request
an urgent request for help or support
a formal written request signed by many people
a formal request for a job or place
a strong request that is hard to refuse

normalIntro.en: Request contains quest, the seeking root of question, so the memory picture is going out to seek something and asking politely for it.
normalIntro.cn: request 含有 quest 这个「寻求」词根，也见于 question，记忆画面是出去寻求并礼貌地开口。

normal.en: Re- means again, and quest means seek: seek again by asking.
normal.cn: re- 表示再次，quest 表示寻求：通过开口再次寻求。

normal.en: Make a request is the standard phrase for the act.
normal.cn: make a request 是表示这个动作的标准搭配。

normal.en: On request means it will be given as soon as someone asks.
normal.cn: on request 意为「一经请求就提供」。

normal.en: At the request of marks who asked for it.
normal.cn: at the request of 标出是谁提出的请求。

normal.en: Compare require: to require is stronger and means need or demand.
normal.cn: 对比 require：语气更强，意为需要或要求。

abstract.en: Picture a note slipped under a hotel room door asking for towels.
abstract.cn: 想象一张纸条从酒店房门下塞进去，要求毛巾。

abstract.en: Imagine a raised hand in a quiet room waiting to be called on.
abstract.cn: 想象安静的房间里举起一只手，等待被点到。

abstract.en: Think of a form filled out and handed across a counter.
abstract.cn: 想象填好的表格被递过柜台。

examples.en: The manager granted her request for leave.
examples.cn: 经理批准了她的休假请求。

examples.en: All requests must be sent in writing.
examples.cn: 所有请求都必须以书面形式提交。

examples.en: Visitors are requested to sign in at the desk.
examples.cn: 请访客在前台登记。

dict_mnemonic.text: re-（再次）+ quest（寻求）＝再次开口寻求，即请求；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: 拉丁语 re-（再次）+ quaerere（寻求、询问）→ requirere（再次寻求）→ 中世纪拉丁语 requesta → 古法语 requeste → 中古英语 request。

sensesIntro.en: The polite act of asking comes first, then the thing asked for, and the verb reuses the same shape for formal asking.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是礼貌开口的动作，再是被请求之物，动词则沿用同一形态表示正式请求。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a polite note passed to someone who can grant what it asks.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张礼貌的纸条递给有能力答应请求的人。

branches.en: The act of asking is the central noun sense.
branches.cn: 开口请求的动作，是核心名词义项。

branches.en: The content of the asking becomes the thing requested.
branches.cn: 询问的内容成为「被请求之物」。

branches.en: The verb repeats the same act in a formal setting.
branches.cn: 动词在正式场合重复同一个动作。

branches.en: Act and object are two sides of one polite exchange.
branches.cn: 动作与对象是一次礼貌往来中的两面。

branches.en: Noun and verb differ only in grammar, not in the asking.
branches.cn: 名词与动词只在语法上不同，请求本身相同。

intro.en: Request is a French-shaped noun built on a Latin prefix and the seeking root quaerere.
intro.cn: request 是法语形态的名词，建立在拉丁前缀与「寻求」词根 quaerere 之上。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- means again, and quaerere means to seek or ask, so requirere is to seek again.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 表示再次，quaerere 表示寻求或询问，所以 requirere 就是「再次寻求」。

items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 request 与 require 开头。

items.example: Quaerere is the root of request and question.
items.exampleCN: quaerere 是 request 与 question 的词根。

items.example: Requirere supplies the stem of request.
items.exampleCN: requirere 提供 request 的词干。
requesta 在法语中变成 requeste。

definition_en: to need something, or to demand it as a rule or condition
core_image: 一张任务清单上，某些条件被画了红圈，缺一项就无法开工
scene: 这份工作需要耐心和稳定的手，体检合格是硬性条件。The job requires patience and careful hands.
sceneCN: 这里 require 是「需要」（第 1 个义项：某事成功所不可缺少的条件）；句意：这份工作需要耐心和一双稳当的手。

senses.title: To need something
senses.definition: to need something in order to happen or succeed
senses.definitionCN: 为了发生或成功而不可缺少某物
senses.example: This plant requires plenty of sunlight.
senses.exampleCN: 这种植物需要充足的阳光。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to seek again, and a need is something the situation keeps seeking.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「再次寻求」，而「需要」正是情境不断寻求的东西。

senses.title: To demand by rule
senses.definition: to officially demand something as a rule or condition
senses.definitionCN: 以规则或条件的形式正式要求某事
senses.example: The law requires drivers to carry a licence.
senses.exampleCN: 法律要求司机携带驾照。
senses.why: An authority can turn a need into an obligation, which gives the word its demanding sense.
senses.whyCN: 权威可以把「需要」变成义务，于是这个词带上了强制要求的意味。

senses.title: To make necessary
senses.definition: to make something necessary as a result or consequence
senses.definitionCN: 作为结果或后果使某事成为必要
senses.example: The repair will require closing the road.
senses.exampleCN: 这次维修将需要封闭道路。
senses.why: If a condition cannot be met without an action, the condition effectively requires the action.
senses.whyCN: 如果缺少某个行动就无法满足条件，这个条件实际上就「要求」了该行动。

intro.en: Require comes from Latin requirere, to seek again, built from re- and quaerere, to seek.
intro.cn: require 来自拉丁语 requirere（再次寻求），由 re- 与 quaerere（寻求）构成。

items.en: Quaerere means to seek, ask, or inquire.
items.cn: quaerere 意为寻求、询问或探问。

items.en: Requirere adds re- and means to look for something, especially something missing.
items.cn: requirere 加上 re-，意为寻找某物，尤指缺失之物。

items.en: The verb develops the sense of needing what is sought.
items.cn: 该动词发展出「需要所寻之物」的意思。

items.en: Old French requerre carries the demand sense into English.
items.cn: 古法语 requerre 把「要求」义带入英语。

items.en: Middle English require covers need, demand, and obligation.
items.cn: 中古英语 require 涵盖需要、要求和义务。

items.en: Modern English uses it for rules, conditions, and logical consequences.
items.cn: 现代英语用它表示规则、条件和逻辑后果。

note.en: Require shares its seeking root with request, and its family includes the noun for a condition and the word for something indispensable.
note.cn: require 与 request 共享「寻求」词根，其词族包括表示条件的名词和表示不可或缺之物的词。

entries.definition: something that is needed or demanded
an official demand for supplies or property
to have to have something in order to manage
to ask for something firmly or officially
to need or deserve a particular action

normalIntro.en: Require and request share the quest root, but require is stronger: it names a need that must be met.
normalIntro.cn: require 与 request 共享 quest 词根，但 require 语气更强：它指向必须被满足的需要。

normal.en: Re- means again, and quire sounds like quest: keep seeking until the need is met.
normal.cn: re- 表示再次，quire 听起来像 quest：一直寻求，直到需要被满足。

normal.en: Require attention means attention is not optional.
normal.cn: require attention 意为关注不是可选项。

normal.en: Require sb to do is the pattern for rules that force an action.
normal.cn: require sb to do 是强制行动的规则句型。

normal.en: As required is the phrase for doing something when a rule says so.
normal.cn: as required 意为「按规则要求去做」。

normal.en: Compare request and require: asking politely versus demanding by need or rule.
normal.cn: 对比 request 与 require：礼貌询问与因需要或规则而要求。

abstract.en: Picture a checklist with red circles around the items that cannot be skipped.
abstract.cn: 想象清单上几个不能跳过的项目被红笔圈出。

abstract.en: Imagine a door that will not open until three conditions are met.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门，必须满足三个条件才会打开。

abstract.en: Think of a recipe that fails if one ingredient is missing.
abstract.cn: 想象一份食谱，少一样材料就会失败。

examples.en: The job requires strong communication skills.
examples.cn: 这份工作需要很强的沟通能力。

examples.en: All passengers are required to show a ticket.
examples.cn: 所有乘客都被要求出示车票。

examples.en: The change will require more time than we expected.
examples.cn: 这项改动将需要比我们预期更多的时间。

dict_mnemonic.text: re-（再次）+ quire（寻求）＝不断寻求、必须有，即需要或要求；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: 拉丁语 re-（再次）+ quaerere（寻求）→ requirere（寻找、索取）→ 古法语 requerre → 中古英语 require。

sensesIntro.en: A need comes first, then a rule that turns the need into an obligation, then the consequence that makes an action necessary.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是需要，再是把需要变成义务的规则，最后是使某个行动成为必要的后果。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a condition circled in red that must be met before anything proceeds.
core.cn: 核心意象：被红笔圈出的条件，不满足就无法继续。

branches.en: The plain need is the basic sense of the verb.
branches.cn: 朴素的需要，是动词的基本义项。

branches.en: A rule turns the need into an official demand.
branches.cn: 规则把需要变成正式要求。

branches.en: A consequence can make an action necessary.
branches.cn: 后果可以使某个行动成为必要。

branches.en: Need and demand both point to something that cannot be skipped.
branches.cn: 需要与要求都指向不可跳过之物。

branches.en: Rules and consequences both force the next step.
branches.cn: 规则与后果都强制下一步行动。

intro.en: Require is a Latin verb formed from a prefix and the seeking root quaerere.
intro.cn: require 是由前缀与「寻求」词根 quaerere 构成的拉丁动词。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- means again, and quaerere means to seek, so requirere is to seek something out.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 表示再次，quaerere 表示寻求，所以 requirere 就是「把某物找出来」。

items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 require 与 request 开头。

items.example: Quaerere is the root of require.
items.exampleCN: quaerere 是 require 的词根。

items.example: Requirere is the Latin source of require.
items.exampleCN: requirere 是 require 的拉丁来源。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词词尾

definition_en: careful study to discover new facts or reach a better understanding
core_image: 一个人把旧资料摊满桌子，一遍遍查找线索
scene: 为了写这篇论文，她花了半年时间查阅地方档案。She spent six months in local archives to research the history of the town.
sceneCN: 这里 research 是「研究」（第 1 个义项：为发现事实而仔细查考）；句意：为了研究这座小镇的历史，她在地方档案馆待了半年。

senses.title: Systematic study of a subject
senses.definition: careful and organized study aimed at discovering facts
senses.definitionCN: 为发现事实而进行的细致、有条理的研究
senses.example: Recent research links sleep to memory.
senses.exampleCN: 最近的研究把睡眠与记忆联系起来。
senses.why: The noun names the whole activity of searching a subject again and again.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词指对某个主题反复搜寻的整个活动。

senses.title: To study a subject carefully
senses.definition: to study something in detail in order to understand it
senses.definitionCN: 为理解某事物而详细研究
senses.example: She researched the history of the town for six months.
senses.exampleCN: 她研究这座小镇的历史研究了半年。
senses.why: The verb is the same repeated searching directed at a question.
senses.whyCN: 动词就是把同样的反复搜寻指向一个问题。

senses.title: Published findings
senses.definition: the results or body of work produced by study
senses.definitionCN: 研究产生的结果或成果集合
senses.example: His research on bees was published last year.
senses.exampleCN: 他关于蜜蜂的研究去年发表了。
senses.why: The activity is often named by its output, especially in academic writing.
senses.whyCN: 这项活动常以成果来指代，在学术写作中尤其如此。

intro.en: Research comes from Old French recerche, a search, from recercher, to seek out, built on re- and cerchier, to search.
intro.cn: research 来自古法语 recerche（搜寻），源于 recercher（找出），由 re- 与 cerchier（搜索）构成。

items.en: Circare means to go around or search through.
items.cn: circare 意为绕行、四处搜寻。

items.en: Cerchier means to search.
items.cn: cerchier 意为搜寻。

items.en: Recercher means to seek out thoroughly.
items.cn: recercher 意为彻底找出。

items.en: Recerche means a search or inquiry.
items.cn: recerche 意为搜寻、探究。

items.en: Middle English researchen means to investigate.
items.cn: 中古英语 researchen 意为调查、探究。

items.en: Modern English uses research for academic and scientific study.
items.cn: 现代英语中，research 用于学术与科学研究。

note.en: Research is a searching word, and it sits near its family and near words for study and inquiry.
note.cn: research 是一个「搜寻」词，与自身词族以及表示学习和探究的词相邻。

entries.definition: third person form of the verb
entries.definitionCN: 动词第三人称单数形式

entries.definition: the activity of learning about a subject

normalIntro.en: Research is re- plus search: to search again and again until the answer appears.
normalIntro.cn: research 是 re- 加 search：一遍又一遍地搜寻，直到答案出现。

normal.en: Re- means again, and search means look for.
normal.cn: re- 表示再一次，search 表示寻找。

normal.en: Do research is the common phrase built on the noun.
normal.cn: do research 是由名词构成的常用短语。

normal.en: Research into a subject means looking closely at it.
normal.cn: research into a subject 意为仔细考察某个主题。

normal.en: A researcher is the person who does the searching.
normal.cn: researcher 就是做搜寻工作的人。

normal.en: Compare study: study can be quiet learning, while research aims at new facts.
normal.cn: 对比 study：study 可以是安静学习，research 则旨在发现新事实。

abstract.en: Picture a table covered with open books and marked pages.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上摊满打开的书和做了标记的纸页。

abstract.en: Imagine a scientist repeating a test to be sure.
abstract.cn: 想象科学家为求确定而重复一次实验。

abstract.en: Think of a single question followed through many files.
abstract.cn: 想象一个问题被追进一摞摞档案。

examples.en: She researched the history of the town for six months.
examples.cn: 她研究这座小镇的历史研究了半年。

examples.en: Recent research links sleep to memory.
examples.cn: 最近的研究把睡眠与记忆联系起来。

examples.en: The team is doing research into clean energy.
examples.cn: 团队正在研究清洁能源。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + search」——一遍又一遍地搜寻，就是研究；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 circare（四处搜寻）→ 古法语 cerchier（搜索）→ recercher（找出）→ recerche（探究）→ 中古英语 researchen → 现代英语 research。

sensesIntro.en: The word is a repeated search: first the activity, then the verb of studying, then the published results of that study.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词就是「反复搜寻」：先指活动，再指研究的动词，最后指研究发表的成果。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a question pursued through piles of evidence.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个问题被追过成堆的证据。

branches.en: Organized study is the main noun sense.
branches.cn: 有条理的研究，是主要名词义项。

branches.en: The verb names the act of searching a subject.
branches.cn: 动词指研究某个主题的行为。

branches.en: Published findings are the visible product of research.
branches.cn: 发表成果是研究可见的产物。

branches.en: The activity and the act are two views of one effort.
branches.cn: 活动与行为是同一种努力的两个视角。

branches.en: Searching produces findings, and findings invite more searching.
branches.cn: 搜寻产生成果，成果又引来更多搜寻。

intro.en: Research is a French-shaped word built on a Latin root for searching, with English endings forming its small family.
intro.cn: research 是建立在拉丁语「搜寻」词根上的法语形态词，小词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin circare means to go around or search, and French cerchier continues that sense.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 circare 意为绕行、搜寻，法语 cerchier 延续这一含义。

items.example: Re- adds the idea of repeating.
Cerchier carries the verb into French.
items.exampleCN: cerchier 把这个动词带入法语。

items.example: Recerche is the direct source of research.
items.exampleCN: recerche 是 research 的直接来源。

definition_en: a firm decision, a formal vote, the solving of a problem, or image sharpness
core_image: 一个人把复杂纠缠的线团一点点解开，最后拉直
scene: 新年第一天，她下定决心每天早起读书。On the first day of the new year, she made a resolution to read every morning.
sceneCN: 这里 resolution 是「决心」（第 1 个义项：坚定的决定）；句意：新年第一天，她下定决心每天早起读书。

senses.title: A firm personal decision
senses.definition: a serious decision to do or stop doing something
senses.definitionCN: 认真决定去做或停止做某事
senses.example: She made a resolution to read every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她下定决心每天早晨读书。
senses.why: The word names the mind settling on a course, like a knot finally pulled straight.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指心思终于定下方向，就像绳结最终被拉直。

senses.title: A formal decision by vote
senses.definition: a formal statement or decision agreed by a group or council
senses.definitionCN: 由团体或委员会表决同意的正式声明或决定
senses.example: The council passed a resolution against the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会通过了一项反对该计划的决议。
senses.why: A group can settle its will as firmly as a person does.
senses.whyCN: 一个群体也能像个人一样坚定地定下意志。

senses.title: The solving of a problem
senses.definition: the act of finding an answer to a difficulty or dispute
senses.definitionCN: 为困难或争端找到答案的行为
senses.example: The resolution of the dispute took months.
senses.exampleCN: 这场争端的解决花了几个月。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to loosen, and solving a problem is loosening it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为松开，而解决问题就是把问题松开。

senses.title: Image sharpness
senses.definition: the amount of detail a screen, image, or lens can show
senses.definitionCN: 屏幕、图像或镜头能显示的细节数量
senses.example: The photograph has very high resolution.
senses.exampleCN: 这张照片的分辨率很高。
senses.why: A high-resolution image can be resolved, or separated, into fine points of detail.
senses.whyCN: 高分辨率图像能被「解析」成细小的细节点。

intro.en: Resolution comes from Latin resolutio, a loosening, from resolvere, to loosen completely, built on re- and solvere.
intro.cn: resolution 来自拉丁语 resolutio（松开），源于 resolvere（彻底解开），由 re- 与 solvere 构成。

items.en: Solvere means to loosen, release, or pay.
items.cn: solvere 意为松开、释放或偿付。

items.en: Resolvere means to loosen completely or dissolve.
items.cn: resolvere 意为彻底解开或溶解。

items.en: Resolutio means a loosening or a settling.
items.cn: resolutio 意为松开、定解。

items.en: Resolution keeps the sense of a firm settling.
items.cn: resolution 保留「坚定定下」的含义。

items.en: Middle English resolution covers decisions and solutions.
items.cn: 中古英语 resolution 兼指决定与解决。

items.en: Modern English adds the sense of screen and image sharpness.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了屏幕与图像分辨率的义项。

note.en: Resolution is the noun of resolve, and it sits near its family and near words for decision and solution.
note.cn: resolution 是 resolve 的名词，与自身词族以及表示决定和解决的词相邻。

entries.definition: to solve a problem or decide firmly
a choice that has been made

normalIntro.en: Resolution is resolve plus -ion: the act of loosening a problem or fixing a decision.
normalIntro.cn: resolution 是 resolve 加 -ion：解开问题或定下决心的行为。

normal.en: Re- means back, and solvere means loosen.
normal.cn: re- 表示回，solvere 表示松开。

normal.en: A New Year's resolution is a promise to yourself.
normal.cn: New Year's resolution 是对自己的承诺。

normal.en: A council resolution is a formal vote.
normal.cn: council resolution 是正式表决。

normal.en: The resolution of a problem is its solution.
normal.cn: 问题的 resolution 就是它的解决办法。

normal.en: High resolution means the image can be resolved into fine detail.
normal.cn: 高分辨率意味着图像能被解析出细腻细节。

abstract.en: Picture a tangled cord straightened strand by strand.
abstract.cn: 想象一团乱绳被一缕缕理直。

abstract.en: Imagine a hand pressing a stamp on a formal paper.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手在正式文件上盖章。

abstract.en: Think of a blurred photo sharpening into clear faces.
abstract.cn: 想象一张模糊照片渐渐显出清晰的面孔。

examples.en: She made a resolution to read every morning.
examples.cn: 她下定决心每天早晨读书。

examples.en: The council passed a resolution against the plan.
examples.cn: 委员会通过了一项反对该计划的决议。

examples.en: The resolution of the dispute took months.
examples.cn: 这场争端的解决花了几个月。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「resolve + ion」——把问题解开、把决心定下，就是 resolution；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 solvere（松开）→ resolvere（彻底解开）→ resolutio（松开、定解）→ 古法语 resolution → 现代英语 resolution。

sensesIntro.en: The noun moves from loosening a problem to settling a decision, then to a formal group vote, and finally to an image resolved into fine detail.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个名词从「解开问题」到「定下决定」，再到群体正式表决，最后指图像被解析出的清晰细节。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tangled problem loosened until it lies straight.
core.cn: 核心意象：纠缠的问题被解开，直到平直。

branches.en: A personal decision is the mind settling on one course.
branches.cn: 个人决心，是心思定在一条路上。

branches.en: A formal vote settles a group's will.
branches.cn: 正式表决定下群体的意志。

branches.en: Solving a problem loosens its difficulties.
branches.cn: 解决问题就是把难处解开。

branches.en: Image sharpness separates a picture into fine points.
branches.cn: 图像分辨率把画面分成细小的点。

branches.en: Both a solution and a sharp image depend on separating detail clearly.
branches.cn: 解决办法与清晰图像都依赖把细节分清楚。

intro.en: Resolution is an English -ion noun built on the Latin verb resolvere.
intro.cn: resolution 是建立在拉丁动词 resolvere 上的英语 -ion 名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin solvere means to loosen, and resolvere means to loosen completely.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 solvere 意为松开，resolvere 意为彻底解开。

items.example: Re- adds the sense of loosening back.
items.exampleCN: re- 增添「往回松开」的意思。

items.example: Resolvere joins the prefix and the root.
items.exampleCN: resolvere 把前缀与词根结合。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的词尾

definition_zh: 负责的；有责任的；可靠的
definition_en: having a duty, being the cause, or being reliable
core_image: 一个人手里握着一串钥匙，要对每扇门负责
scene: 值夜班的护士负责检查每一间病房。The nurse on night duty is responsible for checking every ward.
sceneCN: 这里 responsible 是「负责的」（第 1 个义项：负有职责、须对某事负责）；句意：值夜班的护士负责检查每一间病房。

pos.zh: 负责的；有责任的；可靠的

senses.title: Having a duty or being in charge
senses.definition: having the job of looking after something or someone
senses.definitionCN: 负有照看某物或某人的职责
senses.example: She is responsible for the whole team.
senses.exampleCN: 她负责整个团队。
senses.why: The word comes from a Latin verb meaning to answer in return, so the responsible person is the one who must answer.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自意为「回以答复」的拉丁动词，因此负责的人就是必须作出交代的人。

senses.title: Being the cause of something
senses.definition: being the cause of an event, especially a bad one
senses.definitionCN: 是某事件的原因，尤指坏事件
senses.example: Heavy rain was responsible for the flood.
senses.exampleCN: 大雨是这场洪水的原因。
senses.why: The one who must answer for an event is often the one who caused it.
senses.whyCN: 必须为事件作出交代的人，往往就是造成事件的人。

senses.title: Reliable and sensible
senses.definition: able to be trusted to act sensibly and carefully
senses.definitionCN: 可以被信任，能明智谨慎地行事
senses.example: We need a responsible driver for the night trip.
senses.exampleCN: 夜间出行我们需要一位可靠的司机。
senses.why: A person who answers for their actions is likely to act carefully.
senses.whyCN: 能为自己的行为负责的人，往往会谨慎行事。

senses.title: Accountable to someone
senses.definition: required to report to a person or authority
senses.definitionCN: 须向某人或某机构汇报的
senses.example: The committee is responsible to the whole school.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会对全校负责。
senses.why: Answering in return also means answering to a higher authority.
senses.whyCN: 回以答复也意味着向更高权威作出交代。

intro.en: Responsible comes from Latin respondere, to answer in return, through French responsable, so it means answerable.
intro.cn: responsible 经法语 responsable 来自拉丁语 respondere（回以答复），因此意为「须作出交代的」。

items.en: Respondere means to answer in return.
items.cn: respondere 意为回以答复。

items.en: Responsum means an answer.
items.cn: responsum 意为回答。

items.en: Responsable means answerable.
items.cn: responsable 意为应负责的。

items.en: Responsible covers duty and cause.
items.cn: 英语 responsible 涵盖职责与原因。

items.en: Modern English adds the sense of being reliable.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「可靠」的含义。

note.en: Responsible is an answerable adjective, close to its noun family and to words for accountability.
note.cn: responsible 是表示「应负责」的形容词，与自身名词词族以及表示问责的词相邻。

entries.definitionCN: 应作解释的；负有责任的

normalIntro.en: Responsible means answerable: if something goes wrong, you are the one who must respond.
normalIntro.cn: responsible 意为「须作出交代」：如果出了问题，你就是必须回应的人。

normal.en: Responsible for means in charge of or the cause of.
normal.cn: responsible for 表示负责或造成。

normal.en: Responsible to means answerable to a person.
normal.cn: responsible to 表示向某人负责。

normal.en: A responsible person acts carefully.
normal.cn: responsible person 行事谨慎。

normal.en: The noun responsibility is the duty itself.
normal.cn: 名词 responsibility 指责任本身。

normal.en: Compare accountable: accountable stresses reporting, responsible is broader.
normal.cn: 对比 accountable：accountable 强调汇报，responsible 范围更广。

abstract.en: Picture a person holding keys to every door in a building.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人拿着整栋楼每扇门的钥匙。

abstract.en: Imagine a driver checking the mirror before moving.
abstract.cn: 想象司机起步前检查后视镜。

abstract.en: Think of a captain standing steady at the wheel.
abstract.cn: 想象船长稳稳站在舵轮旁。

examples.en: The teacher is responsible for thirty students.
examples.cn: 这位老师负责三十名学生。

examples.en: Poor planning was responsible for the failure.
examples.cn: 计划不周是失败的原因。

examples.en: She is a responsible and careful worker.
examples.cn: 她是一位可靠而细心的员工。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「response + ible」——出了事必须「回应」的人，就是负责的；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）＋ spondere（承诺）→ respondere（回以答复）→ 法语 responsable → 英语 responsible，核心义「须作出交代的」。

sensesIntro.en: Responsible first means having a duty, then being the cause, then being reliable, and finally being answerable to someone.
sensesIntro.cn: responsible 先指负有职责，再指是原因，再指可靠，最后指向某人负责。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person holding keys and answering for every door.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人拿着钥匙，为每扇门负责。

branches.en: Being in charge is the main sense.
branches.cn: 负责掌管是主要义项。

branches.en: Being the cause is the explanatory sense.
branches.cn: 是原因是解释性义项。

branches.en: Being reliable is the character sense.
branches.cn: 可靠是品格义项。

branches.en: Being answerable to an authority is the reporting sense.
branches.cn: 向权威负责是汇报义项。

branches.en: A person in charge should also be dependable.
branches.cn: 负责的人也应该可靠。

intro.en: Responsible is a Latin answering adjective reshaped by French, with a large English family.
intro.cn: responsible 是经法语改造的拉丁语「答复」形容词，拥有庞大的英语词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin respondere means to answer in return, from spondere, to promise.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 respondere 意为回以答复，源于 spondere（承诺）。

items.exampleCN: responsible 保留应负责的含义。

definition_zh: 休息；剩余部分；依靠；停止
definition_en: to relax, the part that remains, or to be supported by something
core_image: 一个人放下工具，靠在树边歇一口气
scene: 走了很远之后，大家在树荫下休息。After a long walk, everyone rested in the shade.
sceneCN: 这里 rested 是 rest 的过去式，表示「休息」（第 2 个义项：停止活动以恢复体力）；句意：走了很远之后，大家在树荫下休息。

senses.title: The part that remains
senses.definition: the people or things that are left after the others are taken
senses.definitionCN: 其他人或事物被拿走之后剩下的部分
senses.example: I ate one apple and kept the rest.
senses.exampleCN: 我吃了一个苹果，把其余的留着。
senses.why: This sense comes from a different root meaning to remain, and it names what is left behind.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项来自另一个意为「留下」的词根，指被留下的东西。

senses.title: A period of relaxation
senses.definition: a period of time spent relaxing or not working
senses.definitionCN: 用于放松或不工作的一段时间
senses.example: You look tired and need a good rest.
senses.exampleCN: 你看起来很累，需要好好休息。
senses.why: The oldest English sense is bodily rest, a pause from effort.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的英语义项是身体休息，即从劳作中暂停。

senses.title: To relax or stop activity
senses.definition: to stop working or moving in order to recover
senses.definitionCN: 停止工作或移动以恢复体力
senses.example: Let us rest here for a few minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在这里休息几分钟吧。
senses.why: The verb turns the noun of relaxation into an action.
senses.whyCN: 动词把「休息」这一名词转化为动作。

senses.title: To be supported or based on
senses.definition: to be supported by something or to depend on it
senses.definitionCN: 由某物支撑或依赖某物
senses.example: The whole plan rests on one assumption.
senses.exampleCN: 整个计划建立在一个假设之上。
senses.why: Something at rest on a support is held up by it, which gives the sense of depending.
senses.whyCN: 静止在某支撑物上的东西由它托住，因此产生「依赖」的含义。

intro.en: Rest has two sources: Old English ræst, a pause from work, and Old French reste, from Latin restare, to remain.
intro.cn: rest 有两个来源：古英语 ræst（停工歇息）与古法语 reste（源自拉丁语 restare，留下）。

items.en: Ræst means a pause, sleep, or resting place.
items.cn: ræst 意为暂停、睡眠或休息之处。

items.en: Restare means to remain or stand back.
items.cn: restare 意为留下、留在后面。

items.en: Reste means the remainder.
items.cn: reste 意为剩余部分。

items.en: Rest carries both the pause and the remainder senses.
items.cn: 中古英语 rest 同时带有「休息」与「剩余」两种含义。

items.en: Modern English adds rest on, meaning to depend on.
items.cn: 现代英语增加 rest on，表示依赖。

note.en: Rest is a double-rooted word, close to its restful and restless family and to words for breaks and remainders.
note.cn: rest 是双词源词，与 restful、restless 词族以及表示休息和剩余的词相邻。

normalIntro.en: Rest is two words in one coat: the pause from work and the part left over.
normalIntro.cn: rest 是穿着同一件外衣的两个词：从工作中暂停，以及剩下的部分。

normal.en: Take a rest means stop and relax for a while.
normal.cn: take a rest 表示停下来放松一会儿。

normal.en: The rest of the cake is in the fridge.
normal.cn: 剩下的蛋糕在冰箱里。

normal.en: A plan can rest on a single assumption.
normal.cn: 一个计划可能只建立在一个假设上。

normal.en: Restful places help you sleep well.
normal.cn: 宁静的地方有助于睡好。

normal.en: Compare break: a break is shorter, rest can be a longer state.
normal.cn: 对比 break：break 更短，rest 可以是更长的状态。

abstract.en: Picture a traveler setting down a heavy pack.
abstract.cn: 想象旅人放下沉重的背包。

abstract.en: Imagine a spoon resting across the rim of a cup.
abstract.cn: 想象一把勺子横搁在杯沿上。

abstract.en: Think of the last slice left on a plate.
abstract.cn: 想象盘子里剩下的最后一片。

examples.en: We walked for hours and then rested by the river.
examples.cn: 我们走了几个小时，然后在河边休息。

examples.en: She read the first page and skipped the rest.
examples.cn: 她读了第一页，其余部分跳过了。

examples.en: The argument rests on weak evidence.
examples.cn: 这个论点建立在薄弱的证据上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rest」——像人「靠」在椅子上歇一歇，也是剩下的部分；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 ræst（歇息）＋ 古法语 reste（剩余，源自拉丁语 restare「留下」）→ 英语 rest，一身兼有「休息」与「剩余」两义。

sensesIntro.en: Rest first names what remains, then a pause for recovery, then the act of relaxing, and finally being supported by something.
sensesIntro.cn: rest 先指剩余之物，再指恢复体力的暂停，再指放松的动作，最后指由某物支撑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a heavy pack set down and a body leaning back.
core.cn: 核心意象：沉重的背包被放下，身体向后靠。

branches.en: The remainder comes from the Latin remain root.
branches.cn: 剩余部分来自拉丁语「留下」词根。

branches.en: A pause for recovery comes from the Old English root.
branches.cn: 恢复体力的暂停来自古英语词根。

branches.en: The verb of relaxing turns the pause into action.
branches.cn: 休息的动词把暂停变为动作。

branches.en: Being supported links rest to reliance.
branches.cn: 被支撑把 rest 与依赖联系起来。

branches.en: Something at rest lies supported and still.
branches.cn: 静止之物躺在那儿，被支撑着不动。

intro.en: Rest has two roots, and its English family grows with -ful, -less, and -ing.
intro.cn: rest 有两个词根，其英语词族由 -ful、-less 与 -ing 扩展。

latinIntro.en: Latin restare means to remain, from re-, back, and stare, to stand.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 restare 意为留下，由 re-（向后）与 stare（站立）构成。

items.example: Restless describes a need to move.
items.exampleCN: restless 描述想要走动的状态。

definition_en: a place where you pay to sit and eat meals
core_image: 一间亮着灯的店，里面摆着桌椅和热腾腾的饭菜
scene: 我们在一家小餐馆吃了热汤面。We had hot noodle soup at a small restaurant.
sceneCN: 这里 restaurant 是「餐馆」（第 1 个义项：供人付费用餐的场所）；句意：我们在一家小餐馆吃了热汤面。

senses.title: A place serving meals
senses.definition: a place where meals are cooked and served to paying customers
senses.definitionCN: 为付费顾客烹饪并提供饭菜的场所
senses.example: We found a quiet restaurant near the station.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在车站附近找到一家安静的餐馆。
senses.why: French restaurant originally named a restoring broth, then the place that served it.
senses.whyCN: 法语 restaurant 最初指一种恢复体力的汤，后来指供应这种汤的地方。

senses.title: The business itself
senses.definition: the business or organization that runs such a place
senses.definitionCN: 经营这类场所的生意或组织
senses.example: The restaurant employs forty people.
senses.exampleCN: 这家餐馆雇用了四十人。
senses.why: A restaurant can be spoken of as a business, not only as a building.
senses.whyCN: 餐馆不仅可以指建筑，也可以作为生意来谈论。

intro.en: Restaurant comes from French restaurer, to restore, because the first restaurants served a broth believed to restore health.
intro.cn: restaurant 来自法语 restaurer（恢复），因为最早的餐馆供应一种被认为能恢复健康的汤。

items.en: Restaurare means to restore or rebuild.
items.cn: restaurare 意为恢复、重建。

items.en: Restaurer means to restore.
items.cn: restaurer 意为恢复。

items.en: Restaurant first names a restoring broth.
items.cn: restaurant 最初指一种恢复体力的汤。

items.en: The word shifts to the place that serves food.
items.cn: 这个词转为指供应食物的场所。

items.en: English restaurant names a dining place.
items.cn: 英语 restaurant 指用餐场所。

items.en: Modern English uses it for all kinds of dining businesses.
items.cn: 现代英语用它指各类餐饮生意。

note.en: Restaurant is a dining-place word, close to its French-derived relatives and to other eating places.
note.cn: restaurant 是表示用餐场所的词，与法语来源的亲属词以及其他餐饮场所词相邻。

entries.definition: a person who often eats out
a small place serving drinks and light meals
an informal word for a restaurant

normalIntro.en: Restaurant began as a restoring broth: food that puts strength back into you.
normalIntro.cn: restaurant 最初是一种「恢复体力」的汤：让你重新有力气的食物。

normal.en: A restaurant serves meals for payment.
normal.cn: restaurant 为付费顾客提供饭菜。

normal.en: A restaurant owner is a restaurateur.
normal.cn: 餐馆老板是 restaurateur。

normal.en: A restaurant chain runs many branches.
normal.cn: restaurant chain 经营许多分店。

normal.en: Fast-food restaurants serve food quickly.
normal.cn: fast-food restaurant 快速供应食物。

normal.en: Compare café: a café is smaller and often serves drinks.
normal.cn: 对比 café：café 更小，常供应饮品。

abstract.en: Picture a warm window with tables and lamps inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇温暖的窗，里面摆着桌子和灯。

abstract.en: Imagine steam rising from a bowl of soup.
abstract.cn: 想象一碗汤冒着热气。

abstract.en: Think of a waiter carrying plates between tables.
abstract.cn: 想象服务员在桌间端着盘子穿行。

examples.en: The restaurant was full by seven o'clock.
examples.cn: 七点时餐馆已经坐满了。

examples.en: He works as a cook in a French restaurant.
examples.cn: 他在一家法国餐馆当厨师。

examples.en: They opened a second restaurant last spring.
examples.cn: 他们去年春天开了第二家餐馆。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rest + aurant」——进去「歇一歇」再吃顿饭，就是餐馆；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 restaurare（恢复）→ 法语 restaurer → restaurant（恢复体力的汤，后指供应食物的场所）→ 英语 restaurant，核心义「让人恢复精神的用餐处」。

sensesIntro.en: Restaurant first means the place that serves meals, and then the business that operates it.
sensesIntro.cn: restaurant 先指供应饭菜的场所，再指经营它的生意。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lit room where hot food restores tired people.
core.cn: 核心意象：一间亮着灯的房间，热饭让疲惫的人恢复精神。

branches.en: The dining place is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 用餐场所是日常义项。

branches.en: The business sense treats it as an enterprise.
branches.cn: 生意义项把它视为企业。

branches.en: A restaurant is both a room and a company.
branches.cn: 餐馆既是空间也是公司。

branches.en: A café, a diner, and a canteen can all be restaurants.
branches.cn: 咖啡馆、小饭馆与食堂都可以是餐馆。

branches.en: Chains and family restaurants differ in size, not in kind.
branches.cn: 连锁店与家庭餐馆规模不同，性质相同。

intro.en: Restaurant is a French restoring word, with English relatives restaurateur and restaurant-goer.
intro.cn: restaurant 是法语中表示「恢复」的词，英语亲属有 restaurateur 与 restaurant-goer。

latinIntro.en: Latin restaurare means to restore, and French restaurer keeps that sense.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 restaurare 意为恢复，法语 restaurer 保留这一含义。

items.example: Restaurer carries the word into French.
items.exampleCN: restaurer 把这个词带入法语。
restaurant-goer 在 restaurant 后加 goer。

definition_en: something that happens because of an action, event or process
core_image: 石子落入水中，一圈圈波纹向外扩散开来
scene: 连续熬夜之后，他在体检中得到了一个令人担忧的结果。After several late nights, he received a worrying result in his medical check.
sceneCN: 这里 result 是「结果」（第 1 个义项：某个过程或行动带来的结局）；句意：连续熬夜之后，他在体检中得到了一个令人担忧的结果。

senses.title: An outcome
senses.definition: something that happens because of something else
senses.definitionCN: 因其他事物而发生的结果
senses.example: The accident was the result of careless driving.
senses.exampleCN: 这场事故是粗心驾驶的结果。
senses.why: The Latin source means to spring back, and an outcome springs from its cause.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语来源意为弹回，而结果正是从原因中弹出来的。

senses.title: A score or grade
senses.definition: the score or mark achieved in a test or competition
senses.definitionCN: 在考试或比赛中取得的分数或名次
senses.example: Her exam results were the best in the class.
senses.exampleCN: 她的考试成绩是班里最好的。
senses.why: A score is the measured outcome of effort in a test.
senses.whyCN: 分数就是考试努力被测量出来的结果。

senses.title: To cause something
senses.definition: to happen as a consequence, usually with in or from
senses.definitionCN: 作为后果而发生，通常与 in 或 from 连用
senses.example: The delay resulted in a missed flight.
senses.exampleCN: 这次延误导致错过了航班。
senses.why: As a verb, the word points from a cause to whatever it brings about.
senses.whyCN: 作动词时，这个词从原因指向它所带来的一切。

intro.en: Result comes from Latin resultare, to spring back, through French resulter.
intro.cn: result 经法语 resulter 源自拉丁语 resultare（弹回）。

items.en: Saltare means to leap.
items.cn: saltare 意为跳跃。

items.en: Resultare means to spring back.
items.cn: resultare 意为弹回。

items.en: Resulter carries the sense of following from something.
items.cn: resulter 带有「由某事物而来」的含义。

items.en: Result names the outcome that follows a cause.
items.cn: result 指随原因而来的结果。

items.en: The verb result in marks a consequence.
items.cn: 动词短语 result in 标记一种后果。

note.en: Result is close to effect and consequence and pairs with cause.
note.cn: result 与 effect、consequence 相近，并与 cause 相对。

entries.definition: the final result of a process

normalIntro.en: Result is what springs back from a cause, like ripples from a stone.
normalIntro.cn: result 是原因弹回来的东西，就像石子激起的涟漪。

normal.en: As a result means because of what happened.
normal.cn: as a result 意为由于所发生的事。

normal.en: Result in points forward to the effect.
normal.cn: result in 指向后来的结果。

normal.en: Result from points back to the cause.
normal.cn: result from 指向前面的原因。

normal.en: Exam results are measured outcomes.
normal.cn: exam results 是被测量出来的成绩。

normal.en: Compare outcome: a result is immediate, an outcome is the final end.
normal.cn: 对比 outcome：result 较直接，outcome 是最终结局。

abstract.en: Picture a stone dropping and rings spreading out.
abstract.cn: 想象石子落下，一圈圈波纹扩散。

abstract.en: Imagine a ball bouncing back from a wall.
abstract.cn: 想象球从墙上弹回。

abstract.en: Think of a seed that finally shows as a flower.
abstract.cn: 想象一粒种子最终开成花。

examples.en: The result of the vote surprised everyone.
examples.cn: 投票结果让所有人吃惊。

examples.en: She checked her results online.
examples.cn: 她在网上查询了自己的成绩。

examples.en: Heavy rain resulted in the game being canceled.
examples.cn: 大雨导致比赛取消。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（回）＋ sult（跳）」——事情做完后弹回来的东西，就是结果；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）＋ saltare（跳）→ resultare（弹回）→ 法语 resulter → result，核心义「从原因中弹回来的结局」。

sensesIntro.en: Result first names an outcome, then a test score, and as a verb it points to what a cause brings about.
sensesIntro.cn: result 先指结果，再指考试成绩，作动词时指原因所带来的一切。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: ripples spreading from a stone dropped in water.
core.cn: 核心意象：石子入水后向外扩散的波纹。

branches.en: The basic sense is whatever follows from a cause.
branches.cn: 基本义是随原因而来的一切。

branches.en: A score is the measured result of effort.
branches.cn: 分数是努力被测量出的结果。

branches.en: The verb links a cause to its consequence.
branches.cn: 动词把原因与后果连接起来。

branches.en: Exam results are a familiar kind of outcome.
branches.cn: 考试成绩是常见的一类结果。

branches.en: Every result has a cause behind it.
branches.cn: 每个结果背后都有原因。

intro.en: Result is built from re- and Latin saltare, to leap.
intro.cn: result 由 re- 与拉丁语 saltare（跳）构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin resultare means to spring back, like a ball from a wall.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 resultare 意为弹回，如同球从墙上弹回。

items.exampleCN: 法语 resulter 传递了该词。
resulting 描述随之而来的事物。

definition_en: to go back to a place, or to give something back
core_image: 一只鸟沿着熟悉的路线飞回旧巢
scene: 出差一周后，他终于回到了家。After a week away on business, he finally returned home.
sceneCN: 这里 return 是「返回」（第 1 个义项：回到原来的地方）；句意：出差一周后，他终于回到了家。

senses.title: Go back
senses.definition: to go or come back to a place
senses.definitionCN: 回到原来的地方
senses.example: He returned to his office after lunch.
senses.exampleCN: 午饭后他回到了办公室。
senses.why: The French source means turn back, so returning is turning one's path around.
senses.whyCN: 法语来源意为转回，因此 return 就是掉转路程往回走。

senses.title: Give something back
senses.definition: to give something back to its owner or place
senses.definitionCN: 把东西交还给主人或放回原处
senses.example: Please return the key to the front desk.
senses.exampleCN: 请把钥匙还到前台。
senses.why: An object that goes back to its owner also makes a return.
senses.whyCN: 物品回到主人手里，也是一种返回。

senses.title: Profit or gain
senses.definition: the profit made from an investment
senses.definitionCN: 投资所带来的利润
senses.example: The investment brought a good return.
senses.exampleCN: 这项投资带来了不错的回报。
senses.why: Money that comes back with more is a return on what was given.
senses.whyCN: 带着更多钱回来的，就是所投入之物的回报。

senses.title: Give in response
senses.definition: to do something for someone because they did it for you
senses.definitionCN: 因对方为你做了什么而回以同样的行为
senses.example: She returned the favor with a gift.
senses.exampleCN: 她送了一份礼物来回报这份人情。
senses.why: A favor that comes back to the giver is returned.
senses.whyCN: 回到给予者身上的人情，就是被回报了。

intro.en: Return comes from Old French retorner, to turn back, from re- and torner.
intro.cn: return 源自古法语 retorner（转回），由 re- 与 torner 构成。

items.en: Tornare means to turn.
items.cn: tornare 意为转动。

items.en: Retorner means to turn back.
items.cn: retorner 意为转回。

items.en: Return means come back to a place.
items.cn: return 意为回到某地。

items.en: It also covers giving things back and profit.
items.cn: 它也涵盖归还物品与收益。

items.en: In return marks a response or exchange.
items.cn: in return 标记回应或交换。

note.en: Return is close to come back and give back, and has a financial sense.
note.cn: return 与回来、归还相近，并有金融含义。

normalIntro.en: Return is a U-turn: you go back the way you came.
normalIntro.cn: return 就是掉头：沿来路走回去。

normal.en: Return home means go back to your house.
normal.cn: return home 意为回到家里。

normal.en: Return a book means give it back to the library.
normal.cn: return a book 意为把书还给图书馆。

normal.en: In return means as a response.
normal.cn: in return 意为作为回应。

normal.en: A return on investment is the profit it makes.
normal.cn: a return on investment 是投资带来的利润。

normal.en: Compare come back: come back is physical, return also covers giving and profit.
normal.cn: 对比 come back：come back 指身体回来，return 还涵盖归还与收益。

abstract.en: Picture a bird flying back to the same nest.
abstract.cn: 想象一只鸟飞回同一个巢。

abstract.en: Imagine a ball thrown back to the thrower.
abstract.cn: 想象球被扔回投掷者手中。

abstract.en: Think of a coin that comes back with interest.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚带着利息回来的硬币。

examples.en: She returned from the trip on Sunday.
examples.cn: 她星期天旅行归来。

examples.en: He returned the borrowed tools.
examples.cn: 他归还了借来的工具。

examples.en: The shares gave a high return.
examples.cn: 这些股票带来了高回报。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（回）＋ turn（转）」——把方向转回来，就是返回；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（回）＋ tornare（转）→ 古法语 retorner（转回）→ return，核心义「掉转方向往回走」。

sensesIntro.en: Return first means go back, then give something back, then profit that comes back, and finally a response given in exchange.
sensesIntro.cn: return 先指返回，再指归还，再指回到手中的收益，最后指作为交换给出的回应。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bird flying back along a familiar path.
core.cn: 核心意象：沿着熟悉路线飞回的鸟。

branches.en: Going back is the basic sense.
branches.cn: 返回是基本义。

branches.en: Objects also go back to their owners.
branches.cn: 物品也会回到主人处。

branches.en: Money that comes back is a return.
branches.cn: 回来的钱就是收益。

branches.en: A favor given back is returned.
branches.cn: 被回赠的人情就是被回报。

branches.en: Leaving and coming back can be a social exchange.
branches.cn: 离开与回来也可以是一种社交交换。

intro.en: Return is re- plus Latin tornare, to turn.
intro.cn: return 是 re- 加拉丁语 tornare（转）。

latinIntro.en: Latin tornare means to turn, and re- means back.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tornare 意为转动，re- 意为回。

items.example: Returnable describes a bottle that can go back.
items.exampleCN: returnable 描述可退回的瓶子。

items.example: Returned describes an item sent back.
items.exampleCN: returned 描述被退回的物品。

definition_en: to look at something again in order to judge or learn
core_image: 台灯下摊开的笔记，旁边放着一支红笔
scene: 考试前夜，她坐在台灯下复习整学期的笔记。Before the exam, she sat under a lamp and reviewed the notes from the whole term.
sceneCN: 这里 review 是「复习」（第 2 个义项：为学习而重看）；句意：考试前夜，她坐在台灯下复习整学期的笔记。

senses.title: Looking again
senses.definition: to examine something again
senses.definitionCN: 再次检查某事物
senses.example: The committee will review the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会将审查这项计划。
senses.why: Re- means again, so review is to look again.
senses.whyCN: re- 意为再一次，所以 review 就是再看一遍。

senses.title: Studying again
senses.definition: to study material again before a test
senses.definitionCN: 考试前再次学习材料
senses.example: She reviewed her notes before the exam.
senses.exampleCN: 考试前她复习了笔记。
senses.why: Looking again turns into study when a test is near.
senses.whyCN: 临近考试时，重看就变成了复习。

senses.title: Judging a work
senses.definition: to write an opinion about a book, film or play
senses.definitionCN: 对书、电影或戏剧写出看法
senses.example: He reviews films for a local paper.
senses.exampleCN: 他为当地报纸写影评。
senses.why: A review looks again and then judges.
senses.whyCN: 评论是先重看再评判。

intro.en: Review comes from French reveue, a viewing again, from revoir, to see again.
intro.cn: review 源自法语 reveue（再看一次），来自 revoir（再看）。

items.en: Reveue means a viewing again.
items.cn: reveue 意为再看一次。

items.en: Revoir joins re- to voir, to see.
items.cn: revoir 由 re- 与 voir（看）组成。

items.en: Videre, to see, is the deeper root.
items.cn: 拉丁语 videre（看）是更深的词根。

items.en: Review enters English as a look back at something.
items.cn: review 以「回看某物」之意进入英语。

items.en: It also means judging a book or film.
items.cn: 它也指评判一本书或一部电影。

note.en: Review looks again, while revise changes what is seen.
note.cn: review 是再看一遍，revise 是修改所看的内容。

entries.definition: to judge the value of something

normalIntro.en: Review is a second look with a purpose.
normalIntro.cn: review 是有目的的第二次观看。

normal.en: A book review gives an opinion about a book.
normal.cn: book review 是对一本书给出看法。

normal.en: Under review means being examined.
normal.cn: under review 意为正在被审查。

normal.en: Review notes means study them again.
normal.cn: review notes 意为再学一遍笔记。

normal.en: An annual review looks back at the year.
normal.cn: annual review 回顾这一年。

normal.en: Compare preview: preview looks before, review looks again.
normal.cn: 对比 preview：preview 提前看，review 再看一遍。

abstract.en: Picture a red pen moving over old notes.
abstract.cn: 想象红笔在旧笔记上移动。

abstract.en: Imagine a film critic watching a movie twice.
abstract.cn: 想象影评人把一部电影看两遍。

abstract.en: Think of a mirror that lets you see yesterday again.
abstract.cn: 想象一面能让你再看一遍昨天的镜子。

examples.en: The teacher reviewed the lesson with us.
examples.cn: 老师和我们一起回顾了这堂课。

examples.en: Her review of the novel was very kind.
examples.cn: 她对这部小说的评论非常友善。

examples.en: The case is still under review.
examples.cn: 这个案件仍在审查中。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re（再）＋ view（看）」——再看一遍，就是回顾、复习、评论。

root: 法语 revoir（再看）＝ re-（再）＋ voir（看），源自拉丁语 videre（看）→ review，核心义「再看一遍并作出判断」。

sensesIntro.en: Review means to look again, whether at a plan, at notes, or at a work of art.
sensesIntro.cn: review 指再看一遍，无论对象是计划、笔记还是艺术作品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: old notes under a lamp and a red pen.
core.cn: 核心意象：台灯下的旧笔记与红笔。

branches.en: Looking again is the core act.
branches.cn: 再看一遍是核心行为。

branches.en: Study repeats the look before a test.
branches.cn: 复习是在考试前重复这一看。

branches.en: Judging follows the second look.
branches.cn: 评判紧随第二次观看。

branches.en: Both checking and studying begin with looking again.
branches.cn: 审查与复习都从再看一遍开始。

branches.en: A review looks back and then gives an opinion.
branches.cn: 评论先回看，再给出看法。

intro.en: Review combines re-, again, with the Latin root vid, to see.
intro.cn: review 由 re-（再）与拉丁词根 vid（看）组成。

latinIntro.en: The path runs from Latin videre to French voir and then English review.
latinIntro.cn: 这条路径从拉丁语 videre 到法语 voir，再到英语 review。

items.example: Vid appears in video and evident.
items.exampleCN: vid 出现在 video 与 evident 中。

items.example: Revoir brings the word into French.

latinEntries.example: Videre underlies many words about sight.
latinEntries.exampleCN: videre 是许多与视觉有关单词的基础。

definition_en: a white grain used as food, grown in wet fields
core_image: 竹筐里堆着雪白的米粒，旁边是一株稻穗
scene: 南方的水田里，农民弯腰插秧，等到秋天收割稻谷。In the wet fields of the south, farmers bend to plant rice and harvest the grain in autumn.
sceneCN: 这里 rice 是「稻、稻谷」（第 1 个义项：生长在水田中的作物）；句意：南方的水田里，农民弯腰插秧，等到秋天收割稻谷。

senses.title: The plant
senses.definition: a grass plant grown in wet fields
senses.definitionCN: 生长在水田中的禾本科植物
senses.example: Rice grows best in warm, wet fields.
senses.exampleCN: 稻子在温暖湿润的水田里长得最好。
senses.why: The word names the living plant before the food.
senses.whyCN: 这个词先指活着的植物，再指食物。

senses.title: The grain
senses.definition: the white grain taken from the plant
senses.definitionCN: 从植株上收获的白色谷粒
senses.example: The shop sells rice by the kilo.
senses.exampleCN: 商店按公斤卖大米。
senses.why: The harvested grain keeps the same name.
senses.whyCN: 收获的谷粒沿用同一名称。

senses.title: Cooked food
senses.definition: the grain cooked and eaten
senses.definitionCN: 煮熟后食用的米粒
senses.example: We had rice with fish for dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 我们晚餐吃了米饭配鱼。
senses.why: Cooked grain on a plate is the everyday sense.
senses.whyCN: 盘中的熟米是日常含义。

intro.en: Rice comes from Greek oryza through Latin, Italian and French.
intro.cn: rice 从希腊语 oryza 经拉丁语、意大利语和法语传来。

items.en: Oryza names the grain.
items.cn: oryza 指这种谷物。

items.en: Oryza keeps the Greek word.
items.cn: oryza 保留了希腊词。

items.en: Riso shortens the Latin form.
items.cn: riso 缩短了拉丁语形式。

items.en: Ris enters Old French.
items.cn: ris 进入古法语。

items.en: Rice settles as the modern English form.
items.cn: rice 定型为现代英语形式。

note.en: Rice is the grain; a paddy is the field where it grows.
note.cn: rice 是谷物；paddy 是种它的水田。

entries.definition: a small hard seed used as food

normalIntro.en: Rice is the white grain that feeds half the world.
normalIntro.cn: rice 是养活半个世界的白色谷粒。

normal.en: Rice grows in wet fields.
normal.cn: 稻子生长在水田里。

normal.en: A bowl of rice is served with dinner.
normal.cn: 晚餐配一碗米饭。

normal.en: A rice field is a field for rice.
normal.cn: rice field 是种稻的田。

normal.en: Cooked rice is soft and white.
normal.cn: 煮熟的米饭柔软洁白。

normal.en: Compare paddy: a paddy is the field, rice is the crop.
normal.cn: 对比 paddy：paddy 是田，rice 是作物。

abstract.en: Picture a white bowl filled with tiny grains.
abstract.cn: 想象一只装满细小米粒的白碗。

abstract.en: Imagine a field of green stalks reflected in water.
abstract.cn: 想象绿色的稻秆倒映在水中。

abstract.en: Think of a table where one grain feeds many hands.
abstract.cn: 想象一张桌子，一种谷物养活许多双手。

examples.en: Rice is the main food in many countries.
examples.cn: 稻米是许多国家的主食。

examples.en: They plant rice in May.
examples.cn: 他们在五月插秧。

examples.en: She cooked rice for lunch.
examples.cn: 她做了米饭当午饭。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rice」与「rise（升起）」只差一个字母——稻子在水田里一天天长高。

root: 希腊语 oryza（稻米）→ 拉丁语 oryza → 意大利语 riso → 古法语 ris → rice。

sensesIntro.en: Rice names the plant, the grain, and the cooked food in turn.
sensesIntro.cn: rice 依次指稻株、大米和米饭。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: white grains in a bamboo basket beside a rice stalk.
core.cn: 核心意象：竹筐里的白米与旁边的稻穗。

branches.en: The plant is the starting sense.
branches.cn: 稻株是起始含义。

branches.en: The harvested grain keeps the name.
branches.cn: 收获的谷粒沿用这个名字。

branches.en: Cooked rice is the food on the table.
branches.cn: 米饭是桌上的食物。

branches.en: Plant and grain are one crop.
branches.cn: 植株与谷粒是同一作物。

branches.en: The grain becomes food after cooking.
branches.cn: 谷粒煮熟后成为食物。

intro.en: Rice comes from Greek through Latin, Italian and French.
intro.cn: rice 从希腊语经拉丁语、意大利语和法语传来。

latinIntro.en: Latin oryza is the pivot between Greek and the modern forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 oryza 是希腊语与现代形式之间的枢纽。

items.example: Ris is the Old French form.
A ricer presses food into rice-like pieces.
items.exampleCN: 压泥器把食物压成米粒状。
ricey 描述类似米的味道。

latinEntries.example: Oryza passes from Greek into Latin.
latinEntries.exampleCN: oryza 从希腊语进入拉丁语。

definition_en: having a lot of money or containing a lot of something
core_image: 金色麦田里沉甸甸的麦穗
scene: 这里的土壤肥沃，雨水充足，庄稼长得格外茂盛。The soil here is rich, the rain is plentiful, and the crops grow especially well.
sceneCN: 这里 rich 是「肥沃的、丰富的」（第 2 个义项：含有大量有益成分）；句意：这里的土壤肥沃，雨水充足，庄稼长得格外茂盛。

senses.title: Wealthy
senses.definition: having a lot of money
senses.definitionCN: 拥有大量钱财
senses.example: The rich merchant built a large house.
senses.exampleCN: 这位富商建了一座大房子。
senses.why: The oldest sense is having great wealth.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的含义是拥有大量财富。

senses.title: Full of something
senses.definition: containing a lot of something good
senses.definitionCN: 含有大量有益成分
senses.example: The valley has rich soil.
senses.exampleCN: 这个山谷土壤肥沃。
senses.why: Wealth extends from money to any good supply.
senses.whyCN: 财富的含义从金钱延伸到任何充足的资源。

senses.title: Strong in taste
senses.definition: having a strong, full flavor
senses.definitionCN: 味道浓烈饱满
senses.example: The cake is rich in butter and cream.
senses.exampleCN: 这蛋糕黄油和奶油味很浓。
senses.why: A full supply makes food taste full too.
senses.whyCN: 充足的原料让食物味道也饱满。

intro.en: Rich is an old English word from a Germanic root meaning powerful.
intro.cn: rich 是古英语词，来自意为「有权势」的日耳曼词根。

items.en: Rice means powerful or wealthy.
items.cn: rice 意为有权势的或富有的。

items.en: The root is linked to rulers.
items.cn: 这个词根与统治者有关。

items.en: Rex, king, is a distant relative.
items.cn: 拉丁语 rex（国王）是远亲。

items.en: Rich first means powerful and then wealthy.
items.cn: rich 先指有权势，再指富有。

items.en: It also means full of something.
items.cn: 它也指充满某物。

note.en: Rich is about having much; wealthy stresses money and property.
note.cn: rich 强调拥有得多；wealthy 更强调钱财与财产。

entries.definition: in a full or generous way

normalIntro.en: Rich is a field heavy with grain and a pocket full of coins.
normalIntro.cn: rich 是沉甸甸的麦田与装满硬币的口袋。

normal.en: Rich soil grows strong crops.
normal.cn: 肥沃的土壤长出茁壮的庄稼。

normal.en: The rich often give to charities.
normal.cn: 富人常常捐助慈善。

normal.en: Rich flavor means a strong taste.
normal.cn: rich flavor 意为浓郁的味道。

normal.en: A country rich in oil has much oil.
normal.cn: a country rich in oil 是石油丰富的国家。

normal.en: Compare wealthy: wealthy stresses money, rich can mean full of anything.
normal.cn: 对比 wealthy：wealthy 强调钱财，rich 可指充满任何东西。

abstract.en: Picture a wheat field bending under its own weight.
abstract.cn: 想象麦田因麦穗沉重而弯下。

abstract.en: Imagine a cup filled to the very edge.
abstract.cn: 想象一只倒到杯口的杯子。

abstract.en: Think of a voice that fills a whole hall.
abstract.cn: 想象一个充满整个大厅的声音。

examples.en: He grew rich through hard work.
examples.cn: 他靠努力工作富了起来。

examples.en: The region is rich in minerals.
examples.cn: 这个地区矿产丰富。

examples.en: This soup has a rich flavor.
examples.cn: 这汤味道浓郁。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rich」四个字母——r 像饱满的麦穗，ich 读来厚实，像装满的口袋。

root: 古英语 rice（有权势的、富有的）→ rich，核心义「拥有很多、内容充足」。

sensesIntro.en: Rich starts with wealth, extends to any abundant supply, and then to full flavor.
sensesIntro.cn: rich 从财富开始，延伸到任何充足的供给，再指浓郁的味道。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a golden wheat field heavy with grain.
core.cn: 核心意象：麦穗沉甸甸的金色麦田。

branches.en: Wealth is the oldest sense.
branches.cn: 财富是最古老的含义。

branches.en: Any good supply counts as richness.
branches.cn: 任何充足的资源都算丰富。

branches.en: Food with full ingredients tastes rich.
branches.cn: 原料充足的食物味道浓郁。

branches.en: Money and soil are both forms of plenty.
branches.cn: 金钱与土壤都是丰足的形式。

branches.en: A full supply makes a full taste.
branches.cn: 充足的供给带来饱满的味道。

intro.en: Rich is an old English adjective from a Germanic root.
intro.cn: rich 是来自日耳曼词根的古英语形容词。

latinIntro.en: Latin rex, king, is a distant cousin of the root.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 rex（国王）是这个词根的远亲。

items.example: Rice is the oldest recorded form.
items.exampleCN: rice 是现存最古老的形式。
rikja 把财富与权力联系起来。

latinEntries.example: Rex is related to the Germanic root.
latinEntries.exampleCN: rex 与这个日耳曼词根有亲缘关系。

definition_en: to sit on and control a horse, bicycle, or vehicle
core_image: 夕阳下，一个人骑着自行车沿河岸前行
scene: 每个周末，他都骑车沿着河岸走很远。Every weekend, he rides his bicycle a long way along the river.
sceneCN: 这里 ride 是「骑（自行车）」（第 1 个义项：骑乘并控制交通工具或动物）；句意：每个周末，他都骑车沿着河岸走很远。

senses.title: On an animal or bike
senses.definition: to sit on and control a horse or bicycle
senses.definitionCN: 骑在马上或车上并加以控制
senses.example: She learned to ride a horse at six.
senses.exampleCN: 她六岁学会骑马。
senses.why: The oldest sense is sitting on a moving animal.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的含义是骑在移动的动物上。

senses.title: In a vehicle
senses.definition: to travel in a car, bus or train
senses.definitionCN: 乘坐汽车、公交车或火车
senses.example: He rides the bus to work.
senses.exampleCN: 他乘公交车上班。
senses.why: The rider becomes a passenger in a vehicle.
senses.whyCN: 骑乘者变成了车辆中的乘客。

senses.title: A journey or attraction
senses.definition: a trip on an animal or vehicle, or a machine at a fair
senses.definitionCN: 骑乘动物的行程、乘车之旅或游乐设施
senses.example: The children loved the roller coaster ride.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们很喜欢坐过山车。
senses.why: The verb's action becomes a named experience.
senses.whyCN: 动词的行为变成了有名称的体验。

intro.en: Ride comes from Old English ridan, from a Germanic root.
intro.cn: ride 源自古英语 ridan，来自日耳曼词根。

items.en: Ridan means to ride.
items.cn: ridan 意为骑。

items.en: The word is shared by Germanic languages.
items.cn: 这个词在日耳曼语族中通用。

items.en: Ride keeps the horse sense.
items.cn: ride 保留了骑马的含义。

items.en: It extends to buses and trains.
items.cn: 它延伸到公交车和火车。

items.en: A ride also names an amusement.
items.cn: a ride 也指一种游乐设施。

note.en: Ride is sitting on and controlling; drive controls a vehicle from inside.
note.cn: ride 是骑在上面并控制；drive 是在车内驾驶。

entries.definition: to go from place to place
a trip from one place to another

normalIntro.en: Ride is the body moving with a horse, a bike or a bus.
normalIntro.cn: ride 是身体随马、自行车或公交车一起前行。

normal.en: Ride a bike means control it with your hands and feet.
normal.cn: ride a bike 意为用手脚控制自行车。

normal.en: Ride the bus means travel as a passenger.
normal.cn: ride the bus 意为作为乘客出行。

normal.en: Give someone a ride means take them in your car.
normal.cn: give someone a ride 意为开车捎带某人。

normal.en: A roller coaster ride is a fairground experience.
normal.cn: a roller coaster ride 是游乐场体验。

normal.en: Compare drive: you ride a bike but drive a car.
normal.cn: 对比 drive：你 ride 自行车，但 drive 汽车。

abstract.en: Picture a bicycle moving along a river at sunset.
abstract.cn: 想象夕阳下一辆自行车沿河前行。

abstract.en: Imagine a horse and rider moving as one shape.
abstract.cn: 想象马与骑手合成一个移动的轮廓。

abstract.en: Think of a road that carries you without effort.
abstract.cn: 想象一条毫不费力就能带你前行的路。

examples.en: He rides his bike to school.
examples.cn: 他骑自行车上学。

examples.en: We rode the train through the mountains.
examples.cn: 我们乘火车穿过群山。

examples.en: The ferry ride took an hour.
examples.cn: 乘渡船用了一个小时。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ride」与「road（路）」读音接近——上路骑行，就是 ride。

root: 古英语 ridan（骑）→ 中古英语 riden → ride，核心义「骑乘并前进」。

sensesIntro.en: Ride begins with controlling a horse or bicycle, extends to travelling in a vehicle, and ends as a named journey or attraction.
sensesIntro.cn: ride 从控制马或自行车开始，延伸到乘车出行，最后指有名称的旅程或游乐设施。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cyclist moving along a river at sunset.
core.cn: 核心意象：夕阳下沿河骑行的身影。

branches.en: Riding an animal is the oldest sense.
branches.cn: 骑动物是最古老的含义。

branches.en: A passenger also rides a vehicle.
branches.cn: 乘客也 ride 车辆。

branches.en: The trip becomes a named ride.
branches.cn: 行程变成了有名称的 ride。

branches.en: Bikes and buses both carry a rider.
branches.cn: 自行车与公交车都载着骑乘者。

branches.en: A vehicle trip becomes an experience.
branches.cn: 乘车出行变成一种体验。

intro.en: Ride is an old English verb with a Germanic root.
intro.cn: ride 是带有日耳曼词根的古英语动词。

latinIntro.en: It has no Latin source; Old English ridan is the origin.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有拉丁语来源；古英语 ridan 是起源。

items.example: Ridan is the oldest recorded form.
items.exampleCN: ridan 是现存最古老的形式。
ridden 出现在 debt-ridden 中。
